data.body:
Goal:
`kno claim <id>` (and `--peek`) refuses a knot in state `blocked`, but happily serves a knot whose graph carries open `blocked_by` edges. Measured 2026-08-25 in the quilt project: `kno claim quilt-6dae --peek` returned the full action prompt while 6dae had an open blocked_by chain (6dae -> caf0 -> e75d). Dispatched agents then spin up, read the edges, and quit -- wasted spin-ups, and rendered dispatch lists cannot close the gap because the graph churns hourly.

Fix: at claim time (claim, poll, poll --claim), resolve the knot's blocked_by edges against live states; refuse when any blocker is non-terminal, with an error naming the open blockers AND the startable root(s) of each chain (follow blocked_by transitively to knots with no open blockers), e.g.: "refused: blocked by quilt-caf0 (open); chain starts at quilt-e75d". Peek shows the same refusal. States shipped/abandoned/deferred count as closed blockers.

(Provenance: minted from the quilt execution-coach session 2026-08-25 after quilt-caf0's stale "unblocked" dispatch; companion of knots-2c76.)
data.title: claim and poll must refuse a knot with open blocked_by edges
